title: Writing Review
goals: mengulang **semua unit menulis**: kalimat, deskripsi, cerita, esai, ringkasan, pesan

lesson.text: Unit ini mengulang seluruh level **Menulis Lanjutan**. Kerjakan latihan dan kuis, lalu ulangi unit yang masih sulit.

lesson.title: Peta ringkas
table: and, but, so, because, although, who, which
detail spesifik, lima indra, urutan sifat
ganti kata dan struktur, jaga makna
siapa, apa, kapan, di mana, sopan

lesson.title: Rencana mingguan
lesson.text: Senin: satu paragraf deskripsi. Rabu: ringkas satu artikel. Jumat: tulis pesan resmi. Minggu: satu cerita pendek.

items: Variasi kalimat dengan penghubung.
Detail spesifik dalam deskripsi.
Cerita: awal, masalah, akhir.
Esai: thesis, alasan, contoh, kesimpulan.
Parafrase: kata dan struktur berbeda.
Pesan: jelas, sopan, lengkap.

practice.q: Gabungkan dengan "because": "I was late. The bus broke down."
options: I was late because the bus broke down.
I was late because the bus broke down, and.
I was late so the bus broke down.
Because I was late the bus broke down.

practice.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed.
Susun kalimat: "Ketika aku tiba, dia sedang tidur."
practice.answer: When I arrived, he was sleeping.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: When I arrived, he was sleeping.

practice.id: Aku tinggal di rumah karena hujan.
practice.q: I stayed home ___ it was raining.
Penghubung yang menyatakan akibat adalah...
Gabungkan dengan "but": "I like tea. I don't like coffee."
options: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
I like tea, so I don't like coffee.
I like tea because I don't like coffee.
I like tea or I don't like coffee.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang paling baik:
options: Although he was tired, he finished the report.
He was tired. He finished the report. He was tired.
Although he was tired, but he finished the report.
He finished the report tired was he.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: I woke up early and opened the window.
The air was cool and smelled of wet grass.
I could hear birds singing in the trees.
It was the most peaceful morning of the month.
practice.exp: Dari tindakan, indra penciuman, pendengaran, ke kesan akhir.

practice.q: Pilih perbandingan yang wajar:
options: He runs as a wind like.

practice.q: Pilih pembuka deskripsi tempat yang menarik:
options: As soon as I opened the door, the smell of coffee wrapped around me.
I will write about a place.

practice.q: The street is noisy and ___.
Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
The kitchen ___ of fresh bread.
Ganti kata umum "big" dengan yang lebih kuat:
He ___, "I am hungry."
Pilih kalimat dialog yang benar:
Bagian "orientation" berisi...
practice.exp: Orientasi. Jawaban yang tepat: **tokoh, tempat, dan waktu**.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: One sunny morning, Budi walked to school.
Suddenly, he saw a small kitten stuck in a tree.
He put his bag down and climbed carefully.
Finally, he saved the kitten and carried it home.
He felt proud and arrived at school smiling.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: Rani lost her notebook on the bus.
She felt worried because it had all her notes.
She went to the bus office the next morning.
A kind driver had kept the notebook for her.
Rani thanked him and promised to be more careful.

practice.q: ___, they found the way home.
Pilih tense yang tepat: "While I ___ home, it began to rain."
Ketuk kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan.
items: Many people think the internet is dangerous.
I believe it is useful when used carefully.
Firstly, it gives us fast access to information.
Secondly, it also helps us talks with friends.
In conclusion, the internet is a good tool.

practice.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk menyimpulkan:
Pilih thesis yang paling jelas:
options: I believe schools should start later in the morning.
This essay is about school time.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi esai opini pendek yang runtut.
items: Many students use phones in class.
I believe that schools should limit phone use during lessons.
Firstly, phones distract students from learning.
For example, they check messages instead of listening.
In conclusion, clear rules will help students focus.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH sebagai thesis:
options: I believe homework should be limited.
In my opinion, homework helps students.
I strongly think homework is necessary.

practice.q: Pilih thesis yang paling jelas:
options: In my opinion, cities need more bicycle lanes.
There are many cities in the world.

practice.q: Ketuk kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan.
items: Some people prefer living in cities.
In my opinion, villages is better for children.
They are quiet and safe.
Therefore, families should consider moving.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "She bought a new phone."
Pilih parafrase terbaik: "The city has a large population."
options: Many people live in the city.
The city has a large population.

practice.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "Although it was cold, we went swimming."
options: We went swimming even though it was cold.
We did not go swimming because it was cold.
It was cold, so we went swimming.
Because it was hot, we swam.

practice.q: Apa yang dibuang saat meringkas?
Pilih parafrase terbaik: "The teacher explained the lesson."
options: The lesson was explained by the teacher.

practice.q: Mana yang BUKAN teknik parafrase?
Pilih ringkasan terbaik untuk: "The town has a market, a library, and two schools. Most people work in farming. In the evening, the streets are quiet."
options: It is a small farming town with basic services.
The town has two schools and a market.

practice.q: Thank you ___ your help.
Apa yang perlu dihindari dalam pesan singkat?
options: kalimat pendek yang jelas dan langsung
nada sopan yang sesuai dengan pembaca
practice.exp: Lengkap. Jawaban yang tepat: **informasi yang tidak lengkap**.

practice.q: Pilih catatan untuk Ibu yang paling baik:
options: Mom, I've gone to Dina's house. I'll be back at six.
Mom, I am not at home now, but you can call me later.
Mom, Dina's house is quite far from our house in town.
Mom, I have gone out and I will tell you everything later.

practice.q: ___ I ask for a day off on Friday, please?
practice.exp: Could I ask. Jawaban yang tepat: **Could**.

practice.q: Pilih permintaan sopan kepada guru:
options: Could you please send me the notes?
Send me the notes as soon as you can today, please.
Please give me your notes because I really need them.
I want your notes now so that I can study for the test.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could you please send me the notes?**

practice.q: Pilih pengumuman yang menyebut tanggal dan waktu:
options: The school fair will be held on Saturday, 12 May, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
The school fair is going to be a lot of fun for everyone.
Please come to the fair if you have time to visit us.
The school fair is big and there will be many things there.
practice.exp: Kapan. Jawaban yang tepat: **The school fair will be held on Saturday, 12 May, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.**

practice.q: Pilih pesan singkat yang paling jelas:
options: Hi Rani, I'll be ten minutes late. Please start without me.
Hi Rani, I am late because there were many things to do today.
Hello, hello, hello! I will arrive when I can arrive there.
Hi. I will come sometime later, but I do not know when.
The boy who sits there is my cousin.
The boy which sits there is my cousin.
The boy sits there who is my cousin.
The boy whose sits there is my cousin.
quiz.exp: Who. Jawaban yang tepat: **The boy who sits there is my cousin.**

quiz.q: Gabungkan dengan "because": "She was happy. She passed the test."
options: She was happy because she passed the test.
She was happy so she passed the test.
She was happy but she passed the test.
She was happy although she passed the test.

quiz.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi cerita yang runtut.
items: Tom was reading in his room one evening.
Suddenly, all the lights went out.
He found a torch and went to the kitchen.
There he saw that his sister had unplugged the fridge.
They both laughed and plugged it back in.

quiz.q: Pilih ungkapan untuk mengakui pandangan lain:
Pilih parafrase terbaik: "The teacher explained the lesson."
options: The lesson was explained by the teacher.

quiz.q: Pilih parafrase terbaik: "He decided to leave."
options: He made a decision to leave.

quiz.q: Pilih penutup pesan resmi yang baik:
options: See you later, and have a very good evening tonight.
Bye bye! I will talk to you again next time, OK?
Whatever you decide is fine, I do not mind at all.
quiz.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Thank you for your help.**
